member.name: T:FCMService.FcmClient
member.summary: A client for the FCM HTTP v1 provider API. It authenticates each request with an OAuth2 access token obtained from your service-account key and delivers messages to a device token, a topic, or a topic condition.
member.remarks: The client is thread-safe and designed to be long-lived: create one per project and reuse it so the HTTP/2 connection and the cached access token are shared across sends.
